title: The Art of Paraphrase in Thesis Defence

sentences.text: In academic writing, the careful replacement of a word with its synonym can prevent repetition and demonstrate a rich vocabulary, an aim that every thesis candidate should pursue.
sentences.translation: 在学术写作中,用同义词谨慎替换某个单词可以避免重复并展示丰富的词汇量,这是每位论文答辩者都应追求的目标。

sentences.text: During a thesis defence, a member of the committee may ask a candidate to paraphrase the question, and a short summary together with the consolidation of previous argument can show both understanding and control.
sentences.translation: 在论文答辩中,委员会成员可能要求候选人转述问题,而简短概括加上对先前论证的整合,可以同时展示理解力与掌控力。

sentences.text: A supportive committee can usually ask a fair question to reveal the logic of a candidate, whereas a hostile one may expose every weakness, a confrontation that every candidate must face with courage.

lessonGrammar.name: 名词化短语作主语
lessonGrammar.note: the careful replacement of a word with its synonym 将动作名词化,使表达精炼正式,是学术写作的典型句式。
lessonGrammar.sourceExample: In academic writing, the careful replacement of a word with its synonym can prevent repetition and demonstrate a rich vocabulary, an aim that every thesis candidate should pursue.
lessonGrammar.sourceExampleCn: 在学术写作中,用同义词谨慎替换某个单词可以避免重复并展示丰富的词汇量,这是每位论文答辩者都应追求的目标。

lessonGrammar.name: 同义替换避免重复
lessonGrammar.note: 用 prevent repetition 和 demonstrate a rich vocabulary 两个并列谓语说明同义替换的两个作用。

lessonGrammar.name: 过去分词短语作时间状语
lessonGrammar.note: when used with caution 相当于 when it is used with caution,省略主语和 be 动词,是书面语中的常见省略。
lessonGrammar.sourceExample: A thesaurus, when used with caution, can reveal a useful alternative, yet a writer must never accept a new term without respect for its subtle difference in meaning.
lessonGrammar.sourceExampleCn: 同义词词典若谨慎使用,能给出有用的替换词,然而写作者绝不能在不尊重其含义细微差别的情况下接受一个新词。

lessonGrammar.name: yet 表示转折
lessonGrammar.note: yet 引出与前文相反的情况,体现论证的辩证性。
